configurations._comment: Alfred runs as a LaunchAgent (com.msfoundry.alfred) and owns port 8080 — one binary, one process, one port. No command here: a url-only entry ATTACHES to the already-running server instead of starting a competing one. Never add a runtimeExecutable, and never free 8080 to start a dev server; that would kill the production app. To restart, use launchctl unload/load per CLAUDE.md.
configurations.name: alfred
